name: remotion-jizura
description: JIZURA lyric motion on a Remotion canvas (initial scaffold)

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.studio: npm run build && remotion studio examples/index.tsx
scripts.still: npm run build && remotion still examples/index.tsx EmptyScene ../dist/remotion/still.png
scripts.render: npm run build && remotion render examples/index.tsx EmptyScene ../dist/remotion/empty.mp4
